visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a medium shot of a male director with gray hair and glasses, identified as Guillermo del Toro, gesturing as he speaks to a person sitting beside him who is wearing extensive monster facial prosthetics. The background is a dimly lit indoor setting with soft cinematic lighting focusing on the subjects. (2) A vertical movie poster for 'Frankenstein' is displayed, featuring three main characters in 19th-century period costumes and a shadowy monster silhouette at the top, framed by gothic candle graphics. (3) A split-screen visual appears: the top half shows actor Jacob Elordi in a red suit on a red carpet, smiling, while the bottom half shows him in full monster makeup from a dark movie scene. (4) A rapid sequence shows time-lapse footage of a bald cap being applied and makeup artists working on an actor in a studio chair; the lighting is bright and industrial. (5) Cinematic clips from 'Wuthering Heights' show Margot Robbie in a period dress and Jacob Elordi shirtless and long-haired in a dark, atmospheric outdoor and indoor setting with high-contrast cinematic lighting. (6) The screen transitions to a screen recording of a mobile interface where a user types '科學怪人' into a search bar on a white background with a digital magnifying glass icon. (7) A sequence of screen captures displays the 'Taiwan Cloud Library' (台灣雲端書庫) interface, showing various book covers, category lists by region (North, Central, South), and a borrowing button '借閱' on a book detail page. (8) The final phase shows multiple book cover grids being scrolled through, followed by a screen with textual calls to action and a link to the platform description.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional tutorial for the 'Taiwan Cloud Library.' It utilizes the cultural 'hook' of upcoming high-profile literary film adaptations (Frankenstein and Wuthering Heights) starring Jacob Elordi to draw interest. It then transitions into explaining how viewers can access the original literary works for free via the digital library platform, providing a step-by-step mobile UI demonstration.
